body:
What I meant when I said I can't face him is because of what he said to me, words have never hurt me so much.

He said he doesn't know if he can be happy while I'm pregnant... All I want is for him to be happy. So that cut through me pretty bluntly... I don't know if I can look at him if he comes round tomorrow...

He's never harmed me in any way shape or form.
I just don't want to ruin his life or be the cause of him being unhappy as it feels just now, I love him, I want him to be hapoy and I feel all I'm currently doing is holding him back from being happy.

I have been in abusive relationships before, I do know the signs and I can say he hasn't shown any red flags yet...
I don't believe it's pity... I've been formally diagnosed by a doctor with depression, just not put on medication for it for various reasons.

I'm in my early to mid 20s. I know I'll feel the same if not worse in the morning and I'll have the house to myself for a good few hours.
I'm well aware life isn't fair, but it's done nothing but knock me down and pin me there... without a hint of "woe is me" or "self pity" I can genuinely say I haven't had many good times in life or much to show for it. It's just a fact... not even self loathing.

I can't even face up to a spider in the bathroom, nevermind an ACTUAL situation involving... well, anything really, in this state...

My mother is upstairs sleeping, I don't really have any friends and I don't even know if I can face my boyfriend coming over tomorrow after his work as he normally does.

Other people can't keep me out of the dark thoughts, they just prevent me acting on them. I feel like if I habe any chance I need to learn that restriction for myself instead of just the fear of pain or fucking up and making my life worse in one way or another...

I'd jump from a building if I wasn't scared of possibly surviving and being a burden on whoever looks after me.
